summary: Meta AI's Alexandr Wang announced the release of open weights for muse glimmer, a 30B parameter model that runs on a single consumer GPU, with open weights for muse spark 1.2 to follow.

mechanisms.reason: A 30B model explicitly designed to run on a single consumer GPU shifts some inference capability off datacenter hardware onto consumer-grade PCs.
mechanisms.quote: a 30b model that runs on a single consumer gpu

practices.reason: Weights are released today for a named model sized to run on a single consumer GPU, enabling self-hosting or fine-tuning.
practices.quote: excited to be releasing open weights for muse glimmer today, a 30b model that runs on a single consumer gpu

notable_reason: A concrete open-weights release of a named 30B model sized for a single consumer GPU is a specific, actionable disclosure rather than routine promotion.
